mapper.select: SELECT t.flt_req_id, t.STATUS, t.flt_req_date, t.flt_req_number, l.flt_req_ln_id, ( SELECT scvb.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb. VALUE = t.STATUS AND scb.CODE = 'HLS_WFL_STATUS' AND scb.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' ) AS status_n FROM con_floating_rate_req t, con_floating_rate_req_ln l WHERE l.quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND l.flt_req_id = t.flt_req_id order by t.flt_req_number desc
